summary.cpuMeasurementMethod: aggregate CPU-time delta / actual monotonic observation interval; one core = 100%
summary.limitation: ps CPU time has finite resolution; very short-lived helper CPU between samples can be missed. This is a process-tree estimate, not an acoustic or playback correctness qualification. Use Instruments for any borderline result.

measurement.qualification: Hosted idle baseline only; no real-player/line/word/8-hour performance claim.
